decision: Use eta=0.1 eV and dE=0.025 eV for production high-energy integrals; retain eta=0.2 and eta=0.05 as saved controls.
reason: The frozen starting eta=0.2 eV changed Y_H by +6.00% (F=0) and +8.19% (F=1) relative to eta=0.1 eV. Post-processing the same saved states at eta=0.05 eV changed Y_H by -1.75% (F=0) and -3.26% (F=1) relative to eta=0.1 eV, bounding the remaining eta residual below the 5% pilot target.
not_done: No fixed-box comb smoothing, no threshold change, no TDSE rerun, and no post-hoc adjustment based on q or any statistical contrast.
note: This is a numerical-resolution calibration performed identically at both biased and unbiased points before P2.
